description: This file defines the CachePool class for managing in-memory and Redis-based caches for LLM, Embeddings, and SSO tokens, including methods for adding, retrieving, and deleting cache entries, and handling Redis connection setup.

classes.name: CachePool
classes.description: Manages various cache pools for LLM, Embeddings, MCP, and SSO tokens, supporting both in-memory and Redis-based storage depending on environment mode.

methods.name: addSSOTokenCache
methods.description: Adds an SSO token to the cache, using Redis in queue mode or in-memory otherwise.

methods.name: getSSOTokenCache
methods.description: Retrieves an SSO token from the cache, using Redis in queue mode or in-memory otherwise.

methods.name: deleteSSOTokenCache
methods.description: Deletes an SSO token from the cache, using Redis in queue mode or in-memory otherwise.

methods.name: addLLMCache
methods.description: Adds an LLM cache entry, serialized and stored in Redis or in-memory.

methods.name: addEmbeddingCache
methods.description: Adds an Embedding cache entry, serialized and stored in Redis or in-memory.

methods.name: addMCPCache
methods.description: Adds an MCP cache entry in-memory only.

methods.name: getMCPCache
methods.description: Retrieves an MCP cache entry from in-memory only.

methods.name: getLLMCache
methods.description: Retrieves an LLM cache entry, deserializing from Redis or in-memory.

methods.name: getEmbeddingCache
methods.description: Retrieves an Embedding cache entry, deserializing from Redis or in-memory.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the Redis connection if it exists.
